ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)

host_pcb_constraints_summary: Pull-up resistors on CMD and DAT0..DAT3 (10-100 kΩ, typical 50 kΩ) on the host PCB; required for open-drain CMD identification.
Bypass capacitor on VDD (typically 0.1 µF ceramic + 4.7 µF bulk) close to the slot.
ESD protection on the card-edge contacts (TVS diodes or integrated protection on level translators) — required because the contacts are exposed.

Signal-integrity-controlled routing for UHS-I SDR50 (100 MHz) and SDR104 (208 MHz): matched-length CLK + CMD + DAT; impedance-controlled trace (typ 50 Ω single-ended); short trace from the host controller to the slot.
VDDIO supply with controllable 3.3 V ↔ 1.8 V switch for UHS-I — required to perform CMD11 voltage switch.
Hot-insertion-tolerant power switch on VDD (e.g. load-switch with controlled ramp) — required for hot insertion / removal.
fields.card_internal_constraints: Card-internal PDK / SDC / layout constraints are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope. Card-side electrical signoff is at the bus-interface pads only (Section 6 of this spec).
fields.notes: This Physical Layer Simplified Specification defines bus electrical parameters (VIH/VIL thresholds, VDD ranges, bus signal load, peak voltage, leakage, power consumption — Section 6.6 / 6.7) but no internal PDK / floorplan / SDC content. SD host controller IPs (e.g. SDHCI) ship with their own SDC + UPF + DFT files.
